### 1. Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or specific procurement workflow?
*A clear and concise description of what the challenge is (e.g. "When officers review joint-venture bidders, it is difficult to...").*

### 2. Proposed Solution / Enhancement
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it aligns with GFR 2017 / CVC / GeM guidelines.

### 3. Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, rules, or workarounds considered.

### 4. Technical / Architectural Impact
- [ ] Database Schema / Migration Required
- [ ] New Pipeline Step or Evaluator Rule
- [ ] API Endpoint Modification (`backend/api/`)
- [ ] Frontend UI / Component Update (`frontend/`)
- [ ] Ground-Truth Golden Dataset Addition (`data/ground-truth/`)

### 5. Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, regulatory circulars, or mockups about the feature request here.
